# Phase One — Route Family and Verification Map

The Awtsmoos gives each vessel its own work while every vessel remains one creation in His sight;
Awtsmoos.com needs family-specific proof so a game is not judged like a document and an editor is not judged like a static byte.

## Route Families To Discover From Files

- Root/home/navigation/index surfaces.
- `mawgawl` Torah/source/library surfaces.
- `heichelos` and series/content discovery.
- social composer/feed/post/profile/account surfaces.
- apps and editors including Animator.
- games and each gameplay entry.
- media/audio/video/story surfaces.
- auth/session/identity surfaces.
- docs/API/dev tooling intentionally public.
- legacy/experimental/prototype entries.
- fixtures/templates/tests that must not be counted as user routes.

## Family Verification Contracts

### Documents / libraries
Load, readable hierarchy, no overflow, deep links, keyboard navigation, responsive measure, source links, empty/error state, timing.

### Search
Hydration, input, submit, advanced options, loading, results, error, history, source navigation, phone keyboard safety, timing.

### Social / CRUD
Draft/create/read/edit/delete/publish where allowed, validation, preview, persistence, auth state, responsive controls, error recovery.

### Editors
Initialization, non-empty or intentional-empty canvas state, toolbar/properties/timeline response, asset load, resize, keyboard/pointer interaction, error recovery.

### Games
Playable readiness, instructions, keyboard/pointer/touch claims, movement/interaction, objective progress, restart, win/fail state, HUD readability, frame/performance stability.

### Media
Load/play/pause/seek, captions where present, poster/layout, network failure state, mobile controls, lazy loading.

## Concurrency Rules

- Read any route at any time.
- Recheck scoped Git status and active mission claims before production writes.
- Dirty + active owner = audit-only.
- Dirty but clearly our prior work = eligible after hash/readback reconciliation.
- Clean + unclaimed = preferred rewrite candidate.
- Never reset/stash/checkout/clean unrelated work.

## First Planned Tranche

1. Finish Sefarim verification because code already changed.
2. Run complete runtime matrix.
3. Pick highest-impact clean/unclaimed failure.
4. Repair complete route family locally.
5. Rerun matrix and continue.

## NEXT_ACTION

Perform Phase Two critique with at least twenty improvements based on known concurrency, performance, and verification risks.
